decisions.reason: The award-winning hipress geothermal probe clearly exceeds aspirations and extends the firm's core tube competence in a growing geothermal market, so there is no trigger for problemistic search.

The single-U borehole probe is a standard complement within the established geothermal range, and a large firm with slack in a growing industry has little reason to drop it despite the lack of reported results.
The surface technology line supports the geothermal probe portfolio and builds on existing plastics expertise, so it is likely carried as part of the system offer.
Fire-protection steel profiles sit close to the core building-systems business, where demand is regulation-driven and stable, so results likely meet aspirations.
Slim steel profile systems are a core architectural offer close to established products and are likely satisfactory, giving no reason to divert resources.
The decorative surface system is more peripheral and has no reported results, but low incremental cost and the firm's slack favour keeping it.
